title: RC-19 test-file side for the integration and fork suites: before the rails, preflightCli and pauseCli spawned ts-node children with the parent environment (the real .env), preflightCli's child opened and migrated the live DB and called mainnet RPCs, honeypotDeploy.eth called the operator's mainnet RPC directly, eight integration files loaded src/config unmocked, and four fork replays loaded the real config and notifier (alerts to the operator chat, live safety APIs) while the Hardhat child read the real .env

evidence.note: spawnSync(npx ts-node scripts/preflight.ts) with env { ...process.env, ...extraEnv }, shell: true
Test 1 is "run against current .env": no override at all (Test 4 :103 repeats it)
the child imports src/chainRegistry, src/preflight and src/utils/provider and calls dotenv.config()
the child builds a provider and a Wallet from the real PRIVATE_KEY for every enabled chain
src/preflight imports src/utils/db, which opens DB_PATH (cwd/data/bot.db fallback), writes pragmas and migrates at import (src/utils/db.ts:9-24, :232-235)
Test 4 spawns scripts/pause.ts with childEnv = { ...process.env } and only DASHBOARD_API_KEY blanked; scripts/pause.ts:32 calls dotenv.config()
new JsonRpcProvider(process.env.ETH_RPC_URL) and provider.getCode(...) against the operator's mainnet RPC whenever ETH_RPC_URL is set (it is, from the real .env)

bot.ts imports src/config; killswitchCheckpoints, midRunWalletCheck, pauseFlow (Test 9), preflightInvocation, v2HoneypotIntegration, v3HoneypotIntegration and v3LiquidityWait import src/bot without mocking src/config
dotenv.config() at import: CONFIG (including walletPrivateKey) is built from the real .env values
mocks logger and db only: src/config and src/utils/notifier load for real (no send path is called by waitForLiquidity)

evidence.ref: node scratchpad testi-tools/reach.js over the slice-files.ts --snapshot TESTI tree and a git archive of src at 23a6461 (static import graph; vi.mock / vi.doMock targets not traversed; text only, imports no src code)
evidence.note: per file, which of src/utils/db, src/config and src/utils/notifier are reached unmocked; the ledger rows with can_reach_real_state yes are this list plus the two spawning files and honeypotDeploy (importActual partial mocks and the spawned scripts checked by hand)

imports src/bot, src/utils/exitManager, src/chainRegistry and src/anti-rug/detector with no mock: src/config and src/utils/notifier load the real .env (deliberateBuyReplay :143-146, exitStatePersistence :141-146, realLaunchReplay :169-171 the same)
DB_PATH is pointed at a temp file before any src import, so the fork replays do not touch data/bot.db (same in the other three files)
the real handlers the replays drive call live third-party safety APIs (Unicrypt here; honeypot.is and GoPlus alike)
the Hardhat child is spawned with the inherited parent env (shell: true); hardhat.config.ts:9 calls dotenv.config(), loading the real .env into the child (the D-03 documented exemption)

the only network entry that would sign with a real key (DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY) needs --network mainnet, which the fork harness never passes; see the AUD-TESTI-017 trace: no fork path signs with the real key

sibling_sites_checked: All 27 integration and 23 fork files at the base SHA. Integration: spawn sites only preflightCli.test.ts:23,38 and pauseCli.test.ts:27,286; honeypotDeploy.eth.test.ts is the only integration file that constructs a provider on a real URL; every express/http server listens on 127.0.0.1:0; no integration file imports src/utils/db unmocked in-process (the preflightCli child does). Fork: the four replays (captureRehearsal, deliberateBuyReplay, exitStatePersistence, realLaunchReplay) import src unmocked with a temp DB_PATH; antiRugDetector mocks every state-reaching dependency; honeypotChecker / honeypotMultiAmount import only checkerContract and the ABI; snipeLifecycle and realMainnetGate.fork.test import no src. No fork path signs with PRIVATE_KEY or DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY or targets anything but 127.0.0.1:8545 for transactions (AUD-TESTI-017 trace), so there is no new rail-class reach (D-16).
severity_rationale: Same severity and class as the canonical RC-19 entry AUD-RAIL-002 (S1 EXPOSURE), whose test-file side was left to the TESTU/TESTI audits; AUD-TESTU-001 is the unit side. Not a new escalation: linked to ESC-PRE-03 as a rediscovery (PROTOCOL section 4). The spawn sites are the ones D-03 names for spawnRailedChild and the network and DB reaches are what the SAFE-02 rails block; 22-29 re-audits the rails, so it stays a candidate.
recommendation: Keep the rails as the guard (no change in Phase 22). Phase 28: spawn children only through spawnRailedChild with the sentinel env; give preflightCli Test 1 an explicit sentinel environment instead of "the current .env"; move honeypotDeploy.eth out of the integration project (it is a live-chain check: a fork or an operator-run script, never the default suite); mock src/config in every file that imports src/bot.
affected_cases: every case of the files listed under files
escaped_regression: Not a hidden-regression finding: the defect is the side effect. What stays green while it happens: preflightCli Test 1 opens and migrates data/bot.db in its child and calls the mainnet RPC with the operator's key-bearing URL, and passes whether preflight succeeds (exit 0) or fails (exit 1).
status_note: Stays candidate (its recommendation): the rails are the guard and Phase 28 cleans the test files. Fork-side items are the unrun obligations AUD-TESTQ-030 to AUD-TESTQ-035.
